Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for small families. Light enough to travel with.Easy to use. Had last one for a very long time, no hesitation in choosing replacement.
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill. I use it a few times a week. Nice temperature control, convenient, and cooks food perfectly with prominent grill marks. There was not an option for 4.5 stars, so 4 stars. I’d give it a 5 if the flame could kick up a tad more, and if it had a couple more inches of grill area. Overall, I’m very satisfied with this purchase.
Results.Title: Great purchase

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd Q and these are the greatest grills ever. Portable, easy to use and set up, especially with the stand. I have a 2nd home in the mountains and bears destroyed my Q there 3 times. I bought this one to replace my current Home Q and am using the parts from both to make the mountain Q whole again. Did I say easy to work on and repair?
Results.Title: My New Q

Results.ReviewText: Love this little grill! I purchase this as I only need a grill surface for 2 people. This is as good as the big Weber I used previously.
Results.Title: Little, but as reliable as the big brother

Results.ReviewText: I have only used the grill once, but it grilled great
Results.Title: Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear about the defects in the igniter and knob on the grill. Our Care Team will reach out to assist in resolving these issues. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Defects in ingniter alignment and propane knob alignment
Results.Title: Quality not a good as previous Q1200

Results.ReviewText: We love our Weber Q BBQ. In fact, this is the 4th one we have owned in the past 10 years. We like the compact size and ease of use. We especially like this newest one because of the built in thermometer and it fits on the stand we had for our previous Q 1200. It is the perfect size for the two of us.
Results.Title: Great BBQ, the Q is.

Results.ReviewText: Has very consistent temperatures. It also holds the heat in well.
Results.Title: Best grill I have owned

Results.ReviewText: Works great for a small grill, cooks evenly, no flare up
Results.Title: Great little grille

Results.ReviewText: This grill is small and light weight which I wanted for my RV. I got the griddle too which is nice. The grill lights easy and heats up fast enough for me. Perfect for outdoor cooking while we camp
Results.Title: Q1200

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback and are sorry to hear about your disappointing experience with connecting the propane tank to the grill. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we are here to help. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: It’s a great grill however it’s ALWAYS been near impossible to put a new propane tank on these grills.  It’s absolutely infuriating and unnecessary that it is so difficult, literally only 1 time out of 100 does it go on without incident.  I will never get another due to this problem.
Results.Title: Propane Tank location Sucks

Results.ReviewText: This Grill is easy to use. It's a great size for a small family and I love that it doesn't have space hogging multi-gallon LP tanks.
Results.Title: Easy

Results.ReviewText: Had the same model for 12 year & used it every other day.
Results.Title: Excellent grill !!!!

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product represents Weber quality well. heats up quickly, and heat distribution is excellent
Results.Title: My personal experience with Weber Q1200 grill

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill. When you don’t want the hassle of charcoal. This is the ticket.
Results.Title: Awesome purchase

Results.ReviewText: Quality design and construction. heats evenly with good control. easy to clean up after use. very portable design is why I purchased. impressed
Results.Title: Q1200

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback regarding the regulator on the Weber Q1200. So sorry to hear you are having an issue with the grill getting gas flow. We want to know more and offer our assistance to make this right. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Burner and/or regulator doesn't last.  I've had two of these Weber Q BBQ's and both did the same thing.  After about 10-12 times the burner will not longer adjust. Clean it thoroughly each time and it still won't work correctly.  Both did the same thing.  Not worth the money or headaches!
Results.Title: Terrible Grille

Results.ReviewText: Found the perfect small portable gas grill that fits perfectly on my condo balcony & is easy to take on weekend cook outs. The Weber Q 1200 Grill.  Grill marks are amazing. Use Weber grill instructions when grilling results for juicy, tender food for you and your guests.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 is Perfect Fit For Your Cookout

Results.ReviewText: Very well made and quite portable. Somewhat under powered tho if you want to broil hotter and can’t hold a low temp at all so smoking is out. Pretty good for salmon which I cook hi temp, quick and often
Results.Title: Good quality expected better heat

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size and grilling performance; fits our expectations. Very happy with our purchase.
Results.Title: Beautiful!

Results.ReviewText:
I had an issue with the regulator, I contacted Weber and they sent a new one after I tried a couple of there suggestions to fix the problem. I am very satisfied with the way I was treated and will be recommending this product to others.
Thank you Weber
Results.Title: Very satisfied

Results.ReviewText:
Now that I have this grill for our RV adventures I’m starting to see how many others have them here at the campground.
Very efficient cooking grill.
I love it!
Results.Title: It’s great!

Results.ReviewText: This little grill can feed a family of four with no problem. Put a griddle on top and have breakfast. Hook to a 25# tank and don't worry about the little tanks running dry!
Results.Title: Great grill, compact and sturdy

Results.ReviewText: I was gifted this for Christmas and I am obsessed! I love the side trays and the temperature gauge! And the color! Beautiful! I bought my first Weber about 15 years ago and have never had an issue.
Results.Title: Makes Grilling Fun!

Results.ReviewText: This is the third Q-1200 grill I’ve owned in over last 15 years. I like the thermometer, the new igniter system, the 2 fold down tables.
Results.Title: I love the bright red color!!

Results.ReviewText: This Q1200 Weber design is perfect for my wife and I.  We previously had a Weber Genesis 330 and could never build the right amount of heat in it unless we preheated on high for 20 minutes.  This Q1200 needs just 5 minutes to adequately preheat.  Love the simplicity when cleaning it also!
Results.Title: Forget those big inefficient grills…

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect for condo living. My steaks always taste just as good as if they were cooked on a big boy grill. I’ve been a loyal owner of a Weber Q 1200 grill for more than 5 years now and can’t say enough how wonderful this product is.
Results.Title: Best little grill for the money

Results.ReviewText: Great quality small grill. easy to set up, and you have great control of the burner temperature. Only “complaint” is some may find it a bit on the heavy side.. That of course would be expected with the quality materials it is constructed with.
Results.Title: Great Portable Grill

Photos.Caption: Our RV setup with the Q1200

Results.ReviewText: Great portable grill. Superb quality that you actually feel while using. Owned 6 Blackstones and live in our RV. The Blackstones always felt cheap, screws backing out, greasy/messy. I actually enjoy cooking again.
Results.Title: LOVE the quality and functionality of the Q1200

Results.ReviewText: Had a Q 1000 for decades but it needed several repair parts so I bought the second to last Q 1200 in the county! Side tables are convenient and I love the battery powered ignition
Results.Title: Replacement Barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Grill has served me well for nine years. Recently had a minor setback with regulator malfunction. Called for new part and was misdirected to replace 20lb tank gas line. After venting my frustration Maria in customer service reached out to restore my faith in Weber. She provided me with a replacement regulator and a pair of grill tongs. We repaired grill in time to tailgate for Patriots playoff win over Texans. Food was amazing off grill in the snow.
Results.Title: Confidence restored
